decision: Pillar owns ONE primary cluster = the full-service-provider head terms (services/agency/company). KI split synonyms into micro-clusters but all share MOFU/BOFU buyer intent (hire a full-service digital marketing provider); they are too thin for their own pages and splitting would cannibalize the pillar, so firm/online/internet/near-me/small-business fold in as SECONDARY. Service-specific intents (seo, local seo, ppc, etc.) are owned by the spokes — not the pillar.
